svg.title: Agentic Fraud Investigation on TigerGraph & Google Gemini — Animated Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end animated architecture of the TigerGraph + Google Gemini fraud investigation agent across Stage 0 (Schema Engine, Drift Gate, AI+AST GSQL Mapper, DQ-01..06), Adversarial Prompt-Injection Shield, Phase Machine P0–P10, Deterministic Scorecard & D1–D4 Wave Detectors, TigerGraph MCP, and TigerVector 1024-d GraphRAG.
